headline: Analytics rule catalog exported for the first time: 1,293 detectors
summary_md:
This is the analytics mirror's first export, not a day of change to an existing catalog. All 1,293 files under `analytics/` are additions — nothing was modified or removed, so there is no prior baseline to diff against.

Each file is one exported detection rule. Given the size and all-additions shape of this commit, individual rules were not read; see the mirror for the full list.
